g.text: Four equal-size paw-trajectory quartiles are shown only for visualization; every prediction is generated out of fold at the individual-trial level.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b6675

g.text: Observed and reconstructed PSTHs are on the same strict-QC spike-rate scale after 37.5-ms smoothing. The best out-of-fold exemplar in each region is displayed for visualization; population inference does not use this selection.
